titulo: NASA Seeks Partners to Design First Nuclear Reactor for the Moon
cuerpo: NASA is seeking industry partners to develop and test the first nuclear reactor designed to provide electricity on the Moon, a major step toward establishing a sustained human presence on the lunar surface.
